versions.subject: Windows redcannary
versions.detection:
reg:
    Image|endswith: \reg.exe
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' query '
        - '/t '
        - 'REG_SZ'
        - '/s'
hive:
    - CommandLine|contains|all: 
        - '/f '
        - 'HKLM'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/f '
        - 'HKCU'
    - CommandLine|contains: 'HKCU\Software\SimonTatham\PuTTY\Sessions'
condition: reg and hive
versions.spl: Image="*\\reg.exe" CommandLine="* query *" CommandLine="*/t *" CommandLine="*REG_SZ*" CommandLine="*/s*" (CommandLine="*/f *" CommandLine="*HKLM*") OR (CommandLine="*/f *" CommandLine="*HKCU*") OR CommandLine="*HKCU\\Software\\SimonTatham\\PuTTY\\Sessions*"
